data.name: Jibillah
data.gender_notes: Jibillah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root j-b-l, meaning 'to live, to dwell'. Jibillah is a feminine form, signifying the lady of the house or the one who keeps the home alive with her presence. The name Jibillah carries the meaning “The Lady of the House” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jibillah usually hope their child will grow to embody the lady of the house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of comfort, nurturing, and stability in a home and family.
data.etymology: Jibillah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Lady of the House.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jibillah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: In traditional Islamic culture, the role of women as homemakers and caretakers is highly valued. The name Jibillah, reflecting the idea of a woman who keeps her home vibrant and alive, is a source of pride and respect. It represents the nurturing and selfless nature of women in an Islamic context.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jibillah carries the significance of being a giver of life and the essence of a welcoming and comforting home for her family. Further, the name is a reminder of the important role of creating a nurturing and harmonious environment in aligning oneself with the guidance of Allah. The name embodies the essence of a humble servant, always striving to make her home a haven, not just for her loved ones, but for all.
